operations.title: Operations overview
operations.description: Shared task health, waiting work and integrations that need attention. Refresh to load the latest state.
operations.loadFailed: Operations status could not be loaded
operations.loadFailedHelp: Check database availability and the operations migration, then refresh. Previously loaded values may be out of date.

cacheHelp.ready: The cache connection answered a live health probe.
cacheHelp.unavailable: The application uses database fallbacks. Check the Redis service and connectivity; this can increase response times.
cacheHelp.unconfigured: Caching is disabled. Configure the existing Redis connection when shared caching is required.

operations.queuesHelp: Scheduled candidates still need an active feature and an available article balance. Translation queues can include ineligible plans or unpublished source articles. Restore interrupted generation in its tenant editor; review translation failures there before starting new paid work.
operations.tasksHelp: Status is shared across replicas and survives restarts. A successful run has no reported item failures. Tasks appear as not observed until their first run after the monitoring migration.
operations.overdueHelp: No clean completion for more than two expected intervals plus five minutes. Check the scheduler and task logs before rerunning work.

taskFailure.ITEM_FAILURES: The task completed with item failures. Inspect the task audit and the affected tenant before retrying.
taskFailure.TASK_FAILED: The task stopped before completing. Check its server logs and upstream service health; paid generation must be recovered through the editor.

operations.boundedList: Shows at most 20 items that need attention.
operations.noWebhookFailures: No failed or retrying webhook deliveries.
operations.retryConfirm: The recipient may already have processed an earlier attempt, even if Topiqu did not receive a response. Confirm that duplicate delivery is safe. This queues one more attempt with the same delivery ID and unchanged payload so the recipient can deduplicate it. Disabled endpoints are not reactivated.
operations.retryQueued: The existing delivery was queued. The webhook worker will pick it up on its next run.
operations.retryConflict: The delivery is no longer failed, its endpoint is disabled, or its plan is ineligible. Refresh and review its current state.
operations.retryRateLimited: Too many manual retries. Wait ten minutes before trying again.
operations.retryUnavailable: The retry could not be confirmed. Refresh before trying again in case the request already queued it.

reasons.endpointDisabled: The endpoint is disabled or the plan no longer permits webhooks. Review the integration before enabling it.
reasons.endpointAuthorization: The recipient rejected authentication. Check its signature verification and endpoint configuration.
reasons.endpointMissing: The recipient endpoint no longer exists. Correct its address in the integration settings.
reasons.endpointRateLimited: The recipient is rate limiting requests. Wait for its capacity to recover before retrying.
reasons.endpointUnavailable: The recipient returned a server error. Check its health before retrying.
reasons.endpointRejected: The recipient rejected the request. Check its expected event format and response code.
reasons.endpointUnreachable: No usable HTTP response was received. Check DNS, TLS and recipient availability.
reasons.planRequired: The current plan does not support this domain connection. Review the tenant plan.
reasons.domainOwnership: Domain ownership is not confirmed. Review the required TXT record with the domain owner.
reasons.domainDns: DNS verification is unavailable. Check the DNS provider and retry through the existing domain setup workflow.
reasons.domainCertificate: The certificate needs attention or expires soon. Review validation records and renew custom certificates in domain settings.
reasons.domainCleanup: Domain disconnection is still pending. Check provider availability and the existing cleanup workflow.
reasons.domainRouting: The domain is not fully routed. Review its DNS and provider state in the existing domain setup workflow.
